overview_description.description:
Qatar National Bank Alahli is one of the leading financial institutions in Egypt established in April 1978 and ranked as the second-largest private bank in Egypt.
Qatar National Bank Alahli provides its services for more than 1,284,417 clients served by  6,723 banking professionals with a network of 231 branches, along with 861 ATMs & 64,147 Point-of-Sale to serve clients nationwide. Further, a distinctive Call center operates round the clock 7 days a week.
Qatar National Bank Alahli provides dedicated products in corporate banking, financial advisory, project financing, structured financing, trade financing, cash management, and foreign exchange with its competitive offerings, it has managed to establish a strong bond with its various corporate clientele whether large domestic corporations, subsidiaries of multinational companies, medium caps, as well as SMEs.

about_short_description.short_description: Qatar National Bank Alahli is an Egyptian financial organization that offers investment and commercial banking services.

product.name: Commercial Banking Services
product.description: Provides banking solutions for individuals and businesses including deposits, loans, and payment services.

product.name: Investment Banking Services
product.description: Offers advisory and financing services for corporate clients including mergers, acquisitions, and capital raising.

product.name: Retail Banking
product.description: Delivers banking products and services tailored to individual consumers such as savings accounts, credit cards, and mortgages.

product.name: Corporate Banking
product.description: Provides financial services to corporate clients including credit facilities, cash management, and trade finance.

product.name: Trade Finance
product.description: Facilitates import and export transactions through letters of credit, guarantees, and documentary collections.
